beats.say: Fake job offers also come by email, and they look very official.
Everything looks fine, except one line: a registration fee.

subject.text: Congratulations! You were selected for a remote job

body.text: Position: online order operator, 1,400 AZN a month.
Registration fee: 35 AZN.
Send photos of both sides of your ID card.

beats.say: They also want photos of both sides of your ID. That is your identity.

subject.text: Congratulations! You were selected for a remote job

body.text: Registration fee: 35 AZN.
Send photos of both sides of your ID card.

beats.say: A real employer never charges to hire you, and takes documents formally when you are hired.

scenes.prompt: Find the warning signs in this job offer.

subject.text: Congratulations! You were selected for a remote job

body.text: Dear candidate,
Your profile was approved, you are hired without an interview.
Position: online order operator, 1,400 AZN a month, from home.
Registration fee: 35 AZN. Refunded with your first salary.
Reply with photos of both sides of your ID card.
Places are limited, reply within 24 hours.

spots.label: Free mailbox
spots.explain: A company writes from its own domain, not a free mailbox. Anyone can open an address like this.

spots.label: Hired without an interview
spots.explain: A real employer does not hire you without talking to you. This line is meant to excite and rush you.

spots.label: Registration fee
spots.explain: If you are asked to pay to be hired, it is a scam. That money will not come back.

spots.label: ID photo
spots.explain: With an ID photo they can try to open accounts or loans in your name. Hand over documents only when formally hired.

spots.label: Pressure
spots.explain: The deadline keeps you from checking. A real vacancy does not vanish in a day.

scenes.title: Job search mailbox
scenes.intro: You are looking for work and have four emails. Choose the right step for each.

body.text: Dear candidate, thank you for your application on the IshBazar site.
Interview: 7 October, 11:00, at our office in Narimanov district.
Please bring your ID card. No payment of any kind is required.

actions.label: Confirm the interview
actions.feedback: Right. You applied yourself, the company writes from its own domain and asks for no money.

actions.label: Check on the company's site
actions.feedback: Good habit. Finding the number on the company's official site and calling it is the surest check.

actions.label: Report as phishing
actions.feedback: This email is genuine: you applied yourself and no money is asked. If in doubt, call the company's official number.

subject.text: Congratulations! You were selected for a remote job

body.text: You are hired without an interview: 1,400 AZN a month, from home.
Pay the registration fee today to keep your place:
Pay 35 AZN

actions.label: Pay 35 AZN
actions.feedback: The registration fee is the scam itself. If you typed card details, call your bank now.

actions.label: Report as phishing
actions.feedback: Right. An offer that asks you to pay to be hired is a scam.

actions.label: Delete
actions.feedback: Good. Reporting it would protect other candidates too.

subject.text: Warehouse job abroad: 2,800 euro a month, visa on us

body.text: Visa and ticket are on us. No language skills needed.
Just pay 180 AZN for document processing:
Prepare documents

actions.label: Prepare documents
actions.feedback: Once the document fee is paid, the agency will vanish. Check any job abroad only through an officially registered agency.

actions.label: Report as phishing
actions.feedback: Right. High pay with no language needed plus a fee up front is a classic trap.

actions.label: Ask for details
actions.feedback: Replying shows your address is active and brings more pressure. Report and delete it.

subject.text: 3 employers viewed your profile this week

body.text: Update your profile to get better matching vacancies.
Reminder: IshBazar and real employers never ask you for payment or an ID photo.

actions.label: Mark as safe
actions.feedback: Right. This is a routine notice from a site you signed up to, asking for no money or documents.

actions.label: Report as phishing
actions.feedback: This email is safe: it comes from a site you know and asks for nothing. Telling such notices apart matters too.

scenes.prompt: Is this job offer safe or a scam?

body.text: Like videos, 2 AZN each. Paid every day.

cards.explain: Being promised money for likes is how the task scam begins.

messages.text: Your interview is on 7 October at 11:00 at our Narimanov office. Bring your ID card.

cards.explain: You applied, the interview is in person and no money is asked. This is a normal hiring step.

body.text: Your earnings are 340 AZN. Pay 15% tax to withdraw.

cards.explain: If you must pay to withdraw earnings, those earnings do not exist. Do not send a single manat.

subject.text: Work from home: receive and forward parcels

body.text: Receive parcels at home, put on a new label and send them on. 25 AZN per parcel.

cards.explain: Such jobs often move goods bought with stolen cards under your name. In the end you are the one held responsible.

body.text: Applications for the internal competition are taken on the HR portal. There is no fee.

cards.explain: The email comes from your organisation's own domain and points to a portal you know. It asks for no money or documents.

points: If you are asked to pay to be hired, it is a scam.
Never send a photo of your ID by email or messenger.
Check the company on its official site and number.
